## Tables

Here's a well-formed table, doing everything it should.

```````````````````````````````` example
| abc | def |
| --- | --- |
| ghi | jkl |
| mno | pqr |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..4:13 children=1
└── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..4:13 alignments=[none,none] children=3
    ├── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:13 isHeader=true children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:2..1:6 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:3..1:5 literal="abc" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=5:0 scope=1:8..1:12 children=1
    │       └── Text id=5:1 scope=1:9..1:11 literal="def" children=0
    ├── TableRow id=6:0 scope=3:1..3:13 isHeader=false children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=7:0 scope=3:2..3:6 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=7:1 scope=3:3..3:5 literal="ghi" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=8:0 scope=3:8..3:12 children=1
    │       └── Text id=8:1 scope=3:9..3:11 literal="jkl" children=0
    └── TableRow id=9:0 scope=4:1..4:13 isHeader=false children=2
        ├── TableCell id=10:0 scope=4:2..4:6 children=1
        │   └── Text id=10:1 scope=4:3..4:5 literal="mno" children=0
        └── TableCell id=11:0 scope=4:8..4:12 children=1
            └── Text id=11:1 scope=4:9..4:11 literal="pqr" children=0
````````````````````````````````

We're going to mix up the table now; we'll demonstrate that inline formatting
works fine, but block elements don't.  You can also have empty cells, and the
textual alignment of the columns is shown to be irrelevant.

```````````````````````````````` example
Hello!

| _abc_ | セン |
| ----- | ---- |
| 1. Block elements inside cells don't work. | |
| But _**inline elements do**_. | x |

Hi!
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..8:3 children=3
├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:6 children=1
│   └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:6 literal="Hello!" children=0
├── Table id=3:0 scope=3:1..6:37 alignments=[none,none] children=3
│   ├── TableRow id=4:0 scope=3:1..3:18 isHeader=true children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=5:0 scope=3:2..3:8 children=1
│   │   │   └── Emphasis id=5:1 scope=3:3..3:7 children=1
│   │   │       └── Text id=5:2 scope=3:4..3:6 literal="abc" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=6:0 scope=3:10..3:17 children=1
│   │       └── Text id=6:1 scope=3:11..3:16 literal="セン" children=0
│   ├── TableRow id=7:0 scope=5:1..5:48 isHeader=false children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=8:0 scope=5:2..5:45 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=8:1 scope=5:3..5:44 literal="1. Block elements inside cells don't work." children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=9:0 scope=5:47..5:47 children=0
│   └── TableRow id=10:0 scope=6:1..6:37 isHeader=false children=2
│       ├── TableCell id=11:0 scope=6:2..6:32 children=3
│       │   ├── Text id=11:1 scope=6:3..6:6 literal="But " children=0
│       │   ├── Emphasis id=11:2 scope=6:7..6:30 children=1
│       │   │   └── Strong id=11:3 scope=6:8..6:29 children=1
│       │   │       └── Text id=11:4 scope=6:10..6:27 literal="inline elements do" children=0
│       │   └── Text id=11:5 scope=6:31..6:31 literal="." children=0
│       └── TableCell id=12:0 scope=6:34..6:36 children=1
│           └── Text id=12:1 scope=6:35..6:35 literal="x" children=0
└── Paragraph id=13:0 scope=8:1..8:3 children=1
    └── Text id=13:1 scope=8:1..8:3 literal="Hi!" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Here we demonstrate some edge cases about what is and isn't a table.

```````````````````````````````` example
| Not enough table | to be considered table |

| Not enough table | to be considered table |
| Not enough table | to be considered table |

| Just enough table | to be considered table |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- |

| ---- | --- |

|x|
|-|

| xyz |
| --- |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..15:7 children=6
├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:45 children=1
│   └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:45 literal="| Not enough table | to be considered table |" children=0
├── Paragraph id=3:0 scope=3:1..4:45 children=3
│   ├── Text id=3:1 scope=3:1..3:45 literal="| Not enough table | to be considered table |" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak id=3:2 scope=3:46..3:46 children=0
│   └── Text id=3:3 scope=4:1..4:45 literal="| Not enough table | to be considered table |" children=0
├── Table id=4:0 scope=6:1..7:46 alignments=[none,none] children=1
│   └── TableRow id=5:0 scope=6:1..6:46 isHeader=true children=2
│       ├── TableCell id=6:0 scope=6:2..6:20 children=1
│       │   └── Text id=6:1 scope=6:3..6:19 literal="Just enough table" children=0
│       └── TableCell id=7:0 scope=6:22..6:45 children=1
│           └── Text id=7:1 scope=6:23..6:44 literal="to be considered table" children=0
├── Paragraph id=8:0 scope=9:1..9:14 children=1
│   └── Text id=8:1 scope=9:1..9:14 literal="| ---- | --- |" children=0
├── Table id=9:0 scope=11:1..12:3 alignments=[none] children=1
│   └── TableRow id=10:0 scope=11:1..11:3 isHeader=true children=1
│       └── TableCell id=11:0 scope=11:2..11:2 children=1
│           └── Text id=11:1 scope=11:2..11:2 literal="x" children=0
└── Table id=12:0 scope=14:1..15:7 alignments=[none] children=1
    └── TableRow id=13:0 scope=14:1..14:7 isHeader=true children=1
        └── TableCell id=14:0 scope=14:2..14:6 children=1
            └── Text id=14:1 scope=14:3..14:5 literal="xyz" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A "simpler" table, GFM style:

```````````````````````````````` example
abc | def
--- | ---
xyz | ghi
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:9 children=1
└── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..3:9 alignments=[none,none] children=2
    ├── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:9 isHeader=true children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:1..1:3 literal="abc" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=5:0 scope=1:6..1:9 children=1
    │       └── Text id=5:1 scope=1:7..1:9 literal="def" children=0
    └── TableRow id=6:0 scope=3:1..3:9 isHeader=false children=2
        ├── TableCell id=7:0 scope=3:1..3:4 children=1
        │   └── Text id=7:1 scope=3:1..3:3 literal="xyz" children=0
        └── TableCell id=8:0 scope=3:6..3:9 children=1
            └── Text id=8:1 scope=3:7..3:9 literal="ghi" children=0
````````````````````````````````

We are making the parser slighly more lax here. Here is a table with spaces at
the end:

```````````````````````````````` example
Hello!

| _abc_ | セン |
| ----- | ---- |
| this row has a space at the end | | 
| But _**inline elements do**_. | x |

Hi!
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..8:3 children=3
├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:6 children=1
│   └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:6 literal="Hello!" children=0
├── Table id=3:0 scope=3:1..6:37 alignments=[none,none] children=3
│   ├── TableRow id=4:0 scope=3:1..3:18 isHeader=true children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=5:0 scope=3:2..3:8 children=1
│   │   │   └── Emphasis id=5:1 scope=3:3..3:7 children=1
│   │   │       └── Text id=5:2 scope=3:4..3:6 literal="abc" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=6:0 scope=3:10..3:17 children=1
│   │       └── Text id=6:1 scope=3:11..3:16 literal="セン" children=0
│   ├── TableRow id=7:0 scope=5:1..5:38 isHeader=false children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=8:0 scope=5:2..5:34 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=8:1 scope=5:3..5:33 literal="this row has a space at the end" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=9:0 scope=5:36..5:36 children=0
│   └── TableRow id=10:0 scope=6:1..6:37 isHeader=false children=2
│       ├── TableCell id=11:0 scope=6:2..6:32 children=3
│       │   ├── Text id=11:1 scope=6:3..6:6 literal="But " children=0
│       │   ├── Emphasis id=11:2 scope=6:7..6:30 children=1
│       │   │   └── Strong id=11:3 scope=6:8..6:29 children=1
│       │   │       └── Text id=11:4 scope=6:10..6:27 literal="inline elements do" children=0
│       │   └── Text id=11:5 scope=6:31..6:31 literal="." children=0
│       └── TableCell id=12:0 scope=6:34..6:36 children=1
│           └── Text id=12:1 scope=6:35..6:35 literal="x" children=0
└── Paragraph id=13:0 scope=8:1..8:3 children=1
    └── Text id=13:1 scope=8:1..8:3 literal="Hi!" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Table alignment:

```````````````````````````````` example
aaa | bbb | ccc | ddd | eee
:-- | --- | :-: | --- | --:
fff | ggg | hhh | iii | jjj
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:27 children=1
└── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..3:27 alignments=[left,none,center,none,right] children=2
    ├── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:27 isHeader=true children=5
    │   ├── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:1..1:4 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:1..1:3 literal="aaa" children=0
    │   ├── TableCell id=5:0 scope=1:6..1:10 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=5:1 scope=1:7..1:9 literal="bbb" children=0
    │   ├── TableCell id=6:0 scope=1:12..1:16 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=6:1 scope=1:13..1:15 literal="ccc" children=0
    │   ├── TableCell id=7:0 scope=1:18..1:22 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=7:1 scope=1:19..1:21 literal="ddd" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=8:0 scope=1:24..1:27 children=1
    │       └── Text id=8:1 scope=1:25..1:27 literal="eee" children=0
    └── TableRow id=9:0 scope=3:1..3:27 isHeader=false children=5
        ├── TableCell id=10:0 scope=3:1..3:4 children=1
        │   └── Text id=10:1 scope=3:1..3:3 literal="fff" children=0
        ├── TableCell id=11:0 scope=3:6..3:10 children=1
        │   └── Text id=11:1 scope=3:7..3:9 literal="ggg" children=0
        ├── TableCell id=12:0 scope=3:12..3:16 children=1
        │   └── Text id=12:1 scope=3:13..3:15 literal="hhh" children=0
        ├── TableCell id=13:0 scope=3:18..3:22 children=1
        │   └── Text id=13:1 scope=3:19..3:21 literal="iii" children=0
        └── TableCell id=14:0 scope=3:24..3:27 children=1
            └── Text id=14:1 scope=3:25..3:27 literal="jjj" children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Table cell count mismatches

The header and delimiter row must match.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b | c |
| --- | --- |
| this | isn't | okay |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:23 children=1
└── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..3:23 children=5
    ├── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:13 literal="| a | b | c |" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak id=2:2 scope=1:14..1:14 children=0
    ├── Text id=2:3 scope=2:1..2:13 literal="| --- | --- |" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak id=2:4 scope=2:14..2:14 children=0
    └── Text id=2:5 scope=3:1..3:23 literal="| this | isn't | okay |" children=0
````````````````````````````````

But any of the body rows can be shorter. Rows longer
than the header are truncated.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b | c |
| --- | --- | ---
| x
| a | b
| 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..5:21 children=1
└── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..5:21 alignments=[none,none,none] children=4
    ├── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:13 isHeader=true children=3
    │   ├── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:2..1:4 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
    │   ├── TableCell id=5:0 scope=1:6..1:8 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=5:1 scope=1:7..1:7 literal="b" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=6:0 scope=1:10..1:12 children=1
    │       └── Text id=6:1 scope=1:11..1:11 literal="c" children=0
    ├── TableRow id=7:0 scope=3:1..3:3 isHeader=false children=3
    │   ├── TableCell id=8:0 scope=3:2..3:3 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=8:1 scope=3:3..3:3 literal="x" children=0
    │   ├── TableCell id=9:0 scope=3:3..3:3 children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=10:0 scope=3:3..3:3 children=0
    ├── TableRow id=11:0 scope=4:1..4:7 isHeader=false children=3
    │   ├── TableCell id=12:0 scope=4:2..4:4 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=12:1 scope=4:3..4:3 literal="a" children=0
    │   ├── TableCell id=13:0 scope=4:6..4:7 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=13:1 scope=4:7..4:7 literal="b" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=14:0 scope=4:7..4:7 children=0
    └── TableRow id=15:0 scope=5:1..5:21 isHeader=false children=3
        ├── TableCell id=16:0 scope=5:2..5:4 children=1
        │   └── Text id=16:1 scope=5:3..5:3 literal="1" children=0
        ├── TableCell id=17:0 scope=5:6..5:8 children=1
        │   └── Text id=17:1 scope=5:7..5:7 literal="2" children=0
        └── TableCell id=18:0 scope=5:10..5:12 children=1
            └── Text id=18:1 scope=5:11..5:11 literal="3" children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Embedded pipes

Tables with embedded pipes could be tricky.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b |
| --- | --- |
| Escaped pipes are \|okay\|. | Like \| this. |
| Within `\|code\| is okay` too. |
| _**`c\|`**_ \| complex
| don't **\_reparse\_**
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..6:23 children=1
└── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..6:23 alignments=[none,none] children=5
    ├── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:9 isHeader=true children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:2..1:4 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=5:0 scope=1:6..1:8 children=1
    │       └── Text id=5:1 scope=1:7..1:7 literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableRow id=6:0 scope=3:1..3:47 isHeader=false children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=7:0 scope=3:2..3:30 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=7:1 scope=3:3..3:27 literal="Escaped pipes are |okay|." children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=8:0 scope=3:32..3:46 children=1
    │       └── Text id=8:1 scope=3:33..3:44 literal="Like | this." children=0
    ├── TableRow id=9:0 scope=4:1..4:34 isHeader=false children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=10:0 scope=4:2..4:33 children=3
    │   │   ├── Text id=10:1 scope=4:3..4:9 literal="Within " children=0
    │   │   ├── Code id=10:2 scope=4:10..4:25 literal="|code| is okay" children=0
    │   │   └── Text id=10:3 scope=4:26..4:30 literal=" too." children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=11:0 scope=4:34..4:34 children=0
    ├── TableRow id=12:0 scope=5:1..5:24 isHeader=false children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=13:0 scope=5:2..5:24 children=2
    │   │   ├── Emphasis id=13:1 scope=5:3..5:12 children=1
    │   │   │   └── Strong id=13:2 scope=5:4..5:11 children=1
    │   │   │       └── Code id=13:3 scope=5:6..5:9 literal="c|" children=0
    │   │   └── Text id=13:4 scope=5:13..5:22 literal=" | complex" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=14:0 scope=5:24..5:24 children=0
    └── TableRow id=15:0 scope=6:1..6:23 isHeader=false children=2
        ├── TableCell id=16:0 scope=6:2..6:23 children=2
        │   ├── Text id=16:1 scope=6:3..6:8 literal="don't " children=0
        │   └── Strong id=16:2 scope=6:9..6:23 children=1
        │       └── Text id=16:3 scope=6:11..6:21 literal="_reparse_" children=0
        └── TableCell id=17:0 scope=6:23..6:23 children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Oddly-formatted markers

This shouldn't assert.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a |
--- |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..2:5 children=1
└── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..2:5 alignments=[none] children=1
    └── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:5 isHeader=true children=1
        └── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:2..1:4 children=1
            └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Escaping

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b |
| --- | --- |
| \\ | `\\` |
| \\\\ | `\\\\` |
| \_ | `\_` |
| \| | `\|` |
| \a | `\a` |

\\ `\\`

\\\\ `\\\\`

\_ `\_`

\| `\|`

\a `\a`
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..17:7 children=6
├── Table id=2:0 scope=1:1..7:13 alignments=[none,none] children=6
│   ├── TableRow id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:9 isHeader=true children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=4:0 scope=1:2..1:4 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:3..1:3 literal="a" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=5:0 scope=1:6..1:8 children=1
│   │       └── Text id=5:1 scope=1:7..1:7 literal="b" children=0
│   ├── TableRow id=6:0 scope=3:1..3:13 isHeader=false children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=7:0 scope=3:2..3:5 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=7:1 scope=3:3..3:4 literal="\\" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=8:0 scope=3:7..3:12 children=1
│   │       └── Code id=8:1 scope=3:8..3:11 literal="\\\\" children=0
│   ├── TableRow id=9:0 scope=4:1..4:17 isHeader=false children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=10:0 scope=4:2..4:7 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=10:1 scope=4:3..4:6 literal="\\\\" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=11:0 scope=4:9..4:16 children=1
│   │       └── Code id=11:1 scope=4:10..4:15 literal="\\\\\\\\" children=0
│   ├── TableRow id=12:0 scope=5:1..5:13 isHeader=false children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=13:0 scope=5:2..5:5 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=13:1 scope=5:3..5:4 literal="_" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=14:0 scope=5:7..5:12 children=1
│   │       └── Code id=14:1 scope=5:8..5:11 literal="\\_" children=0
│   ├── TableRow id=15:0 scope=6:1..6:13 isHeader=false children=2
│   │   ├── TableCell id=16:0 scope=6:2..6:5 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=16:1 scope=6:3..6:3 literal="|" children=0
│   │   └── TableCell id=17:0 scope=6:7..6:12 children=1
│   │       └── Code id=17:1 scope=6:8..6:10 literal="|" children=0
│   └── TableRow id=18:0 scope=7:1..7:13 isHeader=false children=2
│       ├── TableCell id=19:0 scope=7:2..7:5 children=1
│       │   └── Text id=19:1 scope=7:3..7:4 literal="\\a" children=0
│       └── TableCell id=20:0 scope=7:7..7:12 children=1
│           └── Code id=20:1 scope=7:8..7:11 literal="\\a" children=0
├── Paragraph id=21:0 scope=9:1..9:7 children=2
│   ├── Text id=21:1 scope=9:1..9:3 literal="\\ " children=0
│   └── Code id=21:2 scope=9:4..9:7 literal="\\\\" children=0
├── Paragraph id=22:0 scope=11:1..11:11 children=2
│   ├── Text id=22:1 scope=11:1..11:5 literal="\\\\ " children=0
│   └── Code id=22:2 scope=11:6..11:11 literal="\\\\\\\\" children=0
├── Paragraph id=23:0 scope=13:1..13:7 children=2
│   ├── Text id=23:1 scope=13:1..13:3 literal="_ " children=0
│   └── Code id=23:2 scope=13:4..13:7 literal="\\_" children=0
├── Paragraph id=24:0 scope=15:1..15:7 children=2
│   ├── Text id=24:1 scope=15:1..15:3 literal="| " children=0
│   └── Code id=24:2 scope=15:4..15:7 literal="\\|" children=0

    ├── Text id=25:1 scope=17:1..17:3 literal="\\a " children=0
    └── Code id=25:2 scope=17:4..17:7 literal="\\a" children=0
````````````````````````````````

### a table can be recognised when separated from a paragraph of text without an empty line

```````````````````````````````` example
123
456
| a | b |
| ---| --- |
d | e
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..5:5 children=2
├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..2:3 children=3
│   ├── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:3 literal="123" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak id=2:2 scope=1:4..1:4 children=0
│   └── Text id=2:3 scope=2:1..2:3 literal="456" children=0
└── Table id=3:0 scope=3:1..5:5 alignments=[none,none] children=2
    ├── TableRow id=4:0 scope=3:1..3:9 isHeader=true children=2
    │   ├── TableCell id=5:0 scope=3:2..3:4 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=5:1 scope=3:3..3:3 literal="a" children=0
    │   └── TableCell id=6:0 scope=3:6..3:8 children=1
    │       └── Text id=6:1 scope=3:7..3:7 literal="b" children=0
    └── TableRow id=7:0 scope=5:1..5:5 isHeader=false children=2
        ├── TableCell id=8:0 scope=5:1..5:2 children=1
        │   └── Text id=8:1 scope=5:1..5:1 literal="d" children=0
        └── TableCell id=9:0 scope=5:4..5:5 children=1
            └── Text id=9:1 scope=5:5..5:5 literal="e" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The lead a table is split out of is not a cell, so it is not pipe-unescaped:
an escaped backslash in front of a pipe stays an escaped backslash, and the
inline phase reads the escape the author wrote rather than one this extension
manufactured. Upstream disagrees and the difference is registered.

```````````````````````````````` example
pre \\| lead
| a | b |
| - | - |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:9 children=2
├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:12 children=1
│   └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:12 literal="pre \\| lead" children=0
└── Table id=3:0 scope=2:1..3:9 alignments=[none,none] children=1
    └── TableRow id=4:0 scope=2:1..2:9 isHeader=true children=2
        ├── TableCell id=5:0 scope=2:2..2:4 children=1
        │   └── Text id=5:1 scope=2:3..2:3 literal="a" children=0
        └── TableCell id=6:0 scope=2:6..2:8 children=1
            └── Text id=6:1 scope=2:7..2:7 literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The lead, the header row and its cells are all recovered from the paragraph's
content buffer, and an offset in that buffer is not a column. Inside a block
quote the two differ by the stripped prefix, so this is where reading one as
the other shows: every position below comes from the content-to-source map.

```````````````````````````````` example
> 123
> | a | b |
> | --- | --- |
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..3:15 children=1
└── BlockQuote id=2:0 scope=1:1..3:15 children=2
    ├── Paragraph id=3:0 scope=1:3..1:5 children=1
    │   └── Text id=3:1 scope=1:3..1:5 literal="123" children=0
    └── Table id=4:0 scope=2:3..3:15 alignments=[none,none] children=1
        └── TableRow id=5:0 scope=2:3..2:11 isHeader=true children=2
            ├── TableCell id=6:0 scope=2:4..2:6 children=1
            │   └── Text id=6:1 scope=2:5..2:5 literal="a" children=0
            └── TableCell id=7:0 scope=2:8..2:10 children=1
                └── Text id=7:1 scope=2:9..2:9 literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Strikethroughs

A well-formed strikethrough.

```````````````````````````````` example
A proper ~strikethrough~.
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..1:25 children=1
└── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:25 children=3
    ├── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:9 literal="A proper " children=0
    ├── Strikethrough id=2:2 scope=1:10..1:24 children=1
    │   └── Text id=2:3 scope=1:11..1:23 literal="strikethrough" children=0
    └── Text id=2:4 scope=1:25..1:25 literal="." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Some strikethrough edge cases.

```````````````````````````````` example
These are ~not strikethroughs.

No, they are not~

This ~is ~ legit~ isn't ~ legit.

This is not ~~~~~one~~~~~ huge strikethrough.

~one~ ~~two~~ ~~~three~~~

No ~mismatch~~
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..11:14 children=6
├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:30 children=1
│   └── Text id=2:1 scope=1:1..1:30 literal="These are ~not strikethroughs." children=0
├── Paragraph id=3:0 scope=3:1..3:17 children=1
│   └── Text id=3:1 scope=3:1..3:17 literal="No, they are not~" children=0
├── Paragraph id=4:0 scope=5:1..5:32 children=3
│   ├── Text id=4:1 scope=5:1..5:5 literal="This " children=0
│   ├── Strikethrough id=4:2 scope=5:6..5:17 children=1
│   │   └── Text id=4:3 scope=5:7..5:16 literal="is ~ legit" children=0
│   └── Text id=4:4 scope=5:18..5:32 literal=" isn't ~ legit." children=0
├── Paragraph id=5:0 scope=7:1..7:45 children=1
│   └── Text id=5:1 scope=7:1..7:45 literal="This is not ~~~~~one~~~~~ huge strikethrough." children=0
├── Paragraph id=6:0 scope=9:1..9:25 children=4
│   ├── Strikethrough id=6:1 scope=9:1..9:5 children=1
│   │   └── Text id=6:2 scope=9:2..9:4 literal="one" children=0
│   ├── Text id=6:3 scope=9:6..9:6 literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Strikethrough id=6:4 scope=9:7..9:13 children=1
│   │   └── Text id=6:5 scope=9:9..9:11 literal="two" children=0
│   └── Text id=6:6 scope=9:14..9:25 literal=" ~~~three~~~" children=0
└── Paragraph id=7:0 scope=11:1..11:14 children=1
    └── Text id=7:1 scope=11:1..11:14 literal="No ~mismatch~~" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Using 200 tilde since it overflows the internal buffer
size (100) for parsing delimiters in inlines.c
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~striked~

## HTML tag filter


```````````````````````````````` example
This is <xmp> not okay, but **this** <strong>is</strong>.

<p>This is <xmp> not okay, but **this** <strong>is</strong>.</p>

Nope, I won't have <textarea>.

<p>No <textarea> here either.</p>

<p>This <random /> <thing> is okay</thing> though.</p>

Yep, <totally>okay</totally>.

<!-- HTML comments are okay, though. -->
<!- But we're strict. ->
<! No nonsense. >
<!-- Leave multiline comments the heck alone, though, okay?
Even with {"x":"y"} or 1 > 2 or whatever. Even **markdown**.
-->
<!--- Support everything CommonMark's parser does. -->
<!---->
<!--thistoo-->
.
````````````````````````````````

## Footnotes

```````````````````````````````` example
This is some text![^1]. Other text.[^footnote].

Here's a thing[^other-note].

And another thing[^codeblock-note].

This doesn't have a referent[^nope].


[^other-note]:       no code block here (spaces are stripped away)

[^codeblock-note]:
        this is now a code block (8 spaces indentation)

[^1]: Some *bolded* footnote definition.

Hi!

[^footnote]:
    > Blockquotes can be in a footnote.

        as well as code blocks

    or, naturally, simple paragraphs.

[^unused]: This is unused.
.
````````````````````````````````

## When a footnote is used multiple times, we insert multiple backrefs.

```````````````````````````````` example
This is some text. It has a footnote[^a-footnote].

This footnote is referenced[^a-footnote] multiple times, in lots of different places.[^a-footnote]

[^a-footnote]: This footnote definition should have three backrefs.
.

├── Paragraph id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:50 children=3

│   └── Text id=2:3 scope=1:50..1:50 literal="." children=0
├── Paragraph id=3:0 scope=3:1..3:98 children=4
│   ├── Text id=3:1 scope=3:1..3:27 literal="This footnote is referenced" children=0
│   ├── FootnoteReference id=3:2 scope=3:28..3:40 label="a-footnote" definition=4:0 children=0
│   ├── Text id=3:3 scope=3:41..3:85 literal=" multiple times, in lots of different places." children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Task lists

```````````````````````````````` example
- [ ] foo
- [x] bar
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..2:9 children=1
└── List id=2:0 scope=1:1..2:9 flavor=bullet start=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:9 checked=false children=1
    │   └── Paragraph id=4:0 scope=1:7..1:9 children=1
    │       └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:7..1:9 literal="foo" children=0
    └── ListItem id=5:0 scope=2:1..2:9 checked=true children=1
        └── Paragraph id=6:0 scope=2:7..2:9 children=1
            └── Text id=6:1 scope=2:7..2:9 literal="bar" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Show that a task list and a regular list get processed the same in
the way that sublists are created. If something works in a list
item, then it should work the same way with a task.  The only
difference should be the tasklist marker. So, if we use something
other than a space or x, it won't be recognized as a task item, and
so will be treated as a regular item.

```````````````````````````````` example
- [x] foo
  - [ ] bar
  - [x] baz
- [ ] bim

Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure
- [@] foo
  - [@] bar
  - [@] baz
- [@] bim
.

    │               └── Text id=20:1 scope=9:5..9:11 literal="[@] baz" children=0
    └── ListItem id=21:0 scope=10:1..10:9 checked=null children=1
        └── Paragraph id=22:0 scope=10:3..10:9 children=1
            └── Text id=22:1 scope=10:3..10:9 literal="[@] bim" children=0
````````````````````````````````
Use a larger indent -- a task list and a regular list should produce
the same structure.

```````````````````````````````` example
- [x] foo
    - [ ] bar
    - [x] baz
- [ ] bim

Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure
- [@] foo
    - [@] bar
    - [@] baz
- [@] bim
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..10:9 children=3
├── List id=2:0 scope=1:1..5:0 flavor=bullet start=null tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem id=3:0 scope=1:1..3:13 checked=true children=2
│   │   ├── Paragraph id=4:0 scope=1:7..1:9 children=1
│   │   │   └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:7..1:9 literal="foo" children=0
│   │   └── List id=5:0 scope=2:5..3:13 flavor=bullet start=null tight=true children=2
│   │       ├── ListItem id=6:0 scope=2:5..2:13 checked=false children=1
│   │       │   └── Paragraph id=7:0 scope=2:11..2:13 children=1
│   │       │       └── Text id=7:1 scope=2:11..2:13 literal="bar" children=0
│   │       └── ListItem id=8:0 scope=3:5..3:13 checked=true children=1
│   │           └── Paragraph id=9:0 scope=3:11..3:13 children=1
│   │               └── Text id=9:1 scope=3:11..3:13 literal="baz" children=0
│   └── ListItem id=10:0 scope=4:1..5:0 checked=false children=1
│       └── Paragraph id=11:0 scope=4:7..4:9 children=1
│           └── Text id=11:1 scope=4:7..4:9 literal="bim" children=0
├── Paragraph id=12:0 scope=6:1..6:69 children=1
│   └── Text id=12:1 scope=6:1..6:69 literal="Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure" children=0
└── List id=13:0 scope=7:1..10:9 flavor=bullet start=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem id=14:0 scope=7:1..9:13 checked=null children=2
    │   ├── Paragraph id=15:0 scope=7:3..7:9 children=1
    │   │   └── Text id=15:1 scope=7:3..7:9 literal="[@] foo" children=0
    │   └── List id=16:0 scope=8:5..9:13 flavor=bullet start=null tight=true children=2
    │       ├── ListItem id=17:0 scope=8:5..8:13 checked=null children=1
    │       │   └── Paragraph id=18:0 scope=8:7..8:13 children=1
    │       │       └── Text id=18:1 scope=8:7..8:13 literal="[@] bar" children=0
    │       └── ListItem id=19:0 scope=9:5..9:13 checked=null children=1
    │           └── Paragraph id=20:0 scope=9:7..9:13 children=1
    │               └── Text id=20:1 scope=9:7..9:13 literal="[@] baz" children=0
    └── ListItem id=21:0 scope=10:1..10:9 checked=null children=1
        └── Paragraph id=22:0 scope=10:3..10:9 children=1
            └── Text id=22:1 scope=10:3..10:9 literal="[@] bim" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A task item's checked state is decided by the marker the scanner matched, not
by a substring search over the line. `[x]` inside an unchecked item's own text
answers for the wrong bytes: this item is open and mentions a closed one.
cmark-gfm searches the line and reports it checked; that divergence is
registered as `tasklist-checked-marker`.

```````````````````````````````` example
- [ ] call me [x] later
.
Document id=1:0 scope=1:1..1:23 children=1
└── List id=2:0 scope=1:1..1:23 flavor=bullet start=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem id=3:0 scope=1:1..1:23 checked=false children=1
        └── Paragraph id=4:0 scope=1:7..1:23 children=1
            └── Text id=4:1 scope=1:7..1:23 literal="call me [x] later" children=0
````````````````````````````````
